# Cully v0.11.0

Solo remains your agent's copilot. Team is now a shared workspace for project tasks, handoffs, review evidence and explicitly published lessons.

- Manual-launch Team workspace through MCP and `cully workspace`: OAuth issuer/subject principals, team and project roles, stable tasks with dependencies, atomic claims, board/inbox, portable checkpoints, revision-pinned reported evidence and noncontributing-maintainer acceptance.
- Explicit project learning: private lesson drafts, publish/edit/unshare/delete, source-version checks and maintainer-adopted playbooks. Private solo memory and journals stay separate.
- Migration 006 adds bounded team aggregates and transactional audit events. Apply migrations before serving Team traffic. Managed execution and automatic learning remain planned.
- Installer installs one CLI at `~/.local/bin/cully` and links agent paths to it. `cully setup` requires `--all` or `--mcp-url`; without `--agent` it no longer silently defaults to Codex.
- E2E CI splits Solo setup/memory/session from authenticated Team handoff/review. Workspace routing uses one action contract across access, tasks, review and learning.
- Website tagline is "Your agent's copilot. Your team's workspace." Docs cover Solo/Team modes, capabilities, privacy and deployment limits.

Upgrade: install the v0.11.0 CLI, run the data image's `migrate` command (migration 006), redeploy MCP/data, then reconnect agents with `--mcp-url` and OAuth as needed.
